title: Illustration 27: Working Notes (Continued)
body:
**Explanation:**

**(1) Sacrificing ratio**
Old ratio of Pandit and Pandya = 2:1
New ratio of Pandit, Pandya and Patel = 3:5:1

Sacrifice = Old share - New share
Sacrifice of Pandit = 2/3 - 3/9 = (6-3)/9 = 3/9 = 1/3
Sacrifice of Pandya = 1/3 - 5/9 = (3-5)/9 = -2/9 (Gain)

**(2) Entry for goodwill**
Pandya gains, therefore he will also give goodwill to Pandit

Goodwill payable to Pandya = 2/9 * 2,70,000 = ₹ 60,000
Goodwill payable to Patel = 1/9 * 2,70,000 = ₹ 30,000
Goodwill receivable by Pandit = 3/9 * 2,70,000 = ₹ 90,000

Patel does not bring Goodwill in cash.

**Journal Entries:**
| Particulars | L.F. | Debit (₹) | Credit (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Patel's current A/c ...Dr | | 30,000 | |
| Pandya's capital A/c ...Dr | | 60,000 | |
| To Pandit's capital A/c | | | 90,000 |

Note: As capital of all partners is to be kept in new profit sharing ratio, by taking Patel's capital as base, goodwill of Patel is debited to his current account.

**(3) Capital of partners in new profit-loss sharing ratio**
For 1/9th share of Patel, capital = ₹ 50,000
Total capital of firm = 50,000 * 9/1 = ₹ 4,50,000

Pandit's capital in new firm = 3/9 * 4,50,000 = ₹ 1,50,000
Pandya's capital in new firm = 5/9 * 4,50,000 = ₹ 2,50,000
body_hi:
**स्पष्टीकरण:**

**(1) त्याग का अनुपात (Sacrificing ratio)**
पंडित और पंड्या का पुराना अनुपात = 2:1
पंडित, पंड्या और पटेल का नया अनुपात = 3:5:1

त्याग = पुराना हिस्सा - नया हिस्सा
पंडित का त्याग = 2/3 - 3/9 = (6-3)/9 = 3/9 = 1/3
पंड्या का त्याग = 1/3 - 5/9 = (3-5)/9 = -2/9 (लाभ)

**(2) ख्याति (Goodwill) के लिए प्रविष्टि**
पंड्या को लाभ होता है, इसलिए वह भी पंडित को ख्याति देगा

पंड्या द्वारा देय ख्याति = 2/9 * 2,70,000 = ₹ 60,000
पटेल द्वारा देय ख्याति = 1/9 * 2,70,000 = ₹ 30,000
पंडित द्वारा प्राप्य ख्याति = 3/9 * 2,70,000 = ₹ 90,000

पटेल ख्याति नकद में नहीं लाता है।

**रोजनामचा प्रविष्टियाँ (Journal Entries):**
| विवरण (Particulars) | खा.पृ. (L.F.) | डेबिट (₹) | क्रेडिट (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| पटेल का चालू खाता ...Dr | | 30,000 | |
| पंड्या का पूँजी खाता ...Dr | | 60,000 | |
| To पंडित का पूँजी खाता | | | 90,000 |

नोट: चूँकि सभी साझेदारों की पूँजी नए लाभ-हानि विभाजन अनुपात में रखी जानी है, पटेल की पूँजी को आधार मानकर, पटेल की ख्याति उसके चालू खाते में डेबिट की जाती है।

**(3) नए लाभ-हानि विभाजन अनुपात में साझेदारों की पूँजी**
पटेल के 1/9 हिस्से के लिए, पूँजी = ₹ 50,000
फर्म की कुल पूँजी = 50,000 * 9/1 = ₹ 4,50,000

नई फर्म में पंडित की पूँजी = 3/9 * 4,50,000 = ₹ 1,50,000
नई फर्म में पंड्या की पूँजी = 5/9 * 4,50,000 = ₹ 2,50,000

question:
**Illustration 28:** A and B are partners sharing profit-loss in the ratio of 2:1. The balance sheet of their firm as on 31-3-2016 was as under:

**Balance Sheet**

| Liabilities | Amt. (₹) | Assets | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Capital :** | | Plant-Machinery | 80,000 |
| A : 80,000 | | Building | 50,000 |
| B : 40,000 | 1,20,000 | Stock | 17,000 |
| Reserve fund | 21,000 | Debtors | 50,000 |
| Creditors | 75,000 | - Bad debt reserve : 4,000 | 46,000 |
| Bills payable | 10,000 | Cash-Bank | 33,000 |
| **Total** | **2,26,000** | **Total** | **2,26,000** |

They admitted C as a new partner on 1-4-2016 on following conditions:
(1) A sacrificed 1/12th share and B sacrificed 1/6th share from their profit share in favour of C.
(2) C will bring proportionate capital.
(3) C will bring his share of goodwill in cash. Goodwill is valued at ₹ 1,80,000.
(4) Fixed assets are to be depreciated at 10 %.
(5) All debtors are solvent.
(6) Insurance premium of ₹ 3,000 is to be carried forward to the next year.

Prepare necessary account and the balance sheet.
question_hi:
**चित्रण 28:** A और B 2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटने वाले साझेदार हैं। 31-3-2016 को उनकी फर्म का आर्थिक चिट्ठा (Balance Sheet) इस प्रकार था:

**आर्थिक चिट्ठा**

| देयताएँ (Liabilities) | राशि (₹) | संपत्तियाँ (Assets) | राशि (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **पूँजी (Capital) :** | | संयंत्र-मशीनरी | 80,000 |
| A : 80,000 | | भवन | 50,000 |
| B : 40,000 | 1,20,000 | स्टॉक | 17,000 |
| संचय निधि (Reserve fund) | 21,000 | देनदार | 50,000 |
| लेनदार | 75,000 | - डूबत ऋण संचय : 4,000 | 46,000 |
| देय बिल | 10,000 | रोकड़-बैंक | 33,000 |
| **कुल** | **2,26,000** | **कुल** | **2,26,000** |

उन्होंने 1-4-2016 को निम्नलिखित शर्तों पर C को नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया:
(1) A ने अपने लाभ के हिस्से से 1/12वाँ हिस्सा और B ने 1/6वाँ हिस्सा C के पक्ष में त्याग दिया।
(2) C आनुपातिक पूँजी लाएगा।
(3) C ख्याति का अपना हिस्सा नकद में लाएगा। ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 1,80,000 किया गया है।
(4) स्थायी संपत्तियों पर 10% मूल्यह्रास लगाया जाना है।
(5) सभी देनदार शोधक्षम (solvent) हैं।
(6) ₹ 3,000 के बीमा प्रीमियम को अगले वर्ष के लिए आगे ले जाया जाना है (Prepaid)।

आवश्यक खाते और आर्थिक चिट्ठा तैयार करें।
solution:
**Revaluation Account**
| Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| To Plant-Machinery A/c | 8,000 | By Bad debt reserve A/c | 4,000 |
| To Building A/c | 5,000 | By Prepaid insurance premium A/c | 3,000 |
| | | By Loss transferred to old partners' capital A/c | |
| | | A : 4,000 | |
| | | B : 2,000 | 6,000 |
| **Total** | **13,000** | **Total** | **13,000** |

**Partners' Capital Accounts**
| Particulars | A (₹) | B (₹) | C (₹) | Particulars | A (₹) | B (₹) | C (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| To Revaluation A/c | 4,000 | 2,000 | - | By Balance b/d | 80,000 | 40,000 | - |
| To Balance c/d | 1,05,000 | 75,000 | 60,000 | By Reserve fund A/c | 14,000 | 7,000 | - |
| | | | | By Premium for goodwill A/c | 15,000 | 30,000 | - |
| | | | | By Cash A/c | - | - | 60,000 |
| **Total** | **1,09,000** | **77,000** | **60,000** | **Total** | **1,09,000** | **77,000** | **60,000** |

**Cash Account**
| Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| To Balance b/d | 33,000 | By Balance c/d | 1,38,000 |
| To C's capital A/c | 60,000 | | |
| To Premium for goodwill A/c | 45,000 | | |
| **Total** | **1,38,000** | **Total** | **1,38,000** |

**Balance Sheet as on 1-4-2016 after admission**
| Liabilities | Amt. (₹) | Assets | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Capital :** | | Plant | 72,000 |
| A : 1,05,000 | | Building | 45,000 |
| B : 75,000 | | Stock | 17,000 |
| C : 60,000 | 2,40,000 | Debtors | 50,000 |
| Creditors | 75,000 | Cash | 1,38,000 |
| Bill payable | 10,000 | Prepaid insurance premium | 3,000 |
| **Total** | **3,25,000** | **Total** | **3,25,000** |

**Explanation:**
**(1) Sacrificing ratio**
Old ratio of A and B = 2:1
A's sacrifice = 1/12
B's sacrifice = 1/6 = 2/12
Sacrificing ratio = 1:2

**(2) Goodwill**
C's share = A's sacrifice + B's sacrifice = 1/12 + 2/12 = 3/12 = 1/4
Goodwill brought by C = 1/4 * 1,80,000 = ₹ 45,000
C's share of Goodwill ₹ 45,000 is to be distributed between A and B in their sacrificing ratio 1:2.

**(3) C's capital**
A's capital in new firm = 1,05,000
B's capital in new firm = 75,000
Total capital of A and B = 1,80,000
C's share in profit = 1/4
Total share in profit of A and B = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4
For 3/4 share, combined capital of A and B = 1,80,000
For 1/4 share, C's capital = 1,80,000 * 1/4 * 4/3 = ₹ 60,000

question:
**Illustration 29:** Chandni and Nihar are the partners sharing profit in the ratio of 3:2. Their balance sheet as on 31-3-2016 was as under:

**Balance Sheet**

| Liabilities | Amt. (₹) | Assets | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Creditors | 64,000 | Bank | 56,000 |
| General reserve | 12,000 | Debtors | 80,000 |
| Investment fluctuation reserve | 6,000 | - Provision for bad debt : 4,000 | 76,000 |
| Workmen profit sharing fund | 45,000 | Investment | 90,000 |
| **Capital account :** | | Building | 60,000 |
| Chandni : 1,00,000 | | Machinery | 25,000 |
| Nihar : 80,000 | 1,80,000 | | |
| **Total** | **3,07,000** | **Total** | **3,07,000** |

On 1-4-2016, they admitted Payal as a new partner on the following conditions:
(1) Payal brought ₹ 20,000 as goodwill in cash.
(2) Provision for doubtful debt is not required.
(3) Value of machinery is to be reduced by 10 %.
(4) Market value of building is ₹ 1,00,000.
(5) Market value of investments is ₹ 98,500.
(6) Payal will bring 20 % of total capital of Chandni and Nihar in the new firm as her capital.
(7) New profit sharing ratio is to be kept at 2:2:1.
(8) Chandni and Nihar will maintain their capital in the proportion of their new profit and loss sharing ratio.

Prepare necessary accounts and balance sheet.
question_hi:
**चित्रण 29:** चाँदनी और निहार 3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ बाँटने वाले साझेदार हैं। 31-3-2016 को उनका आर्थिक चिट्ठा इस प्रकार था:

**आर्थिक चिट्ठा**

| देयताएँ (Liabilities) | राशि (₹) | संपत्तियाँ (Assets) | राशि (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| लेनदार | 64,000 | बैंक | 56,000 |
| सामान्य संचय (General reserve) | 12,000 | देनदार | 80,000 |
| निवेश उतार-चढ़ाव संचय | 6,000 | - संदिग्ध ऋण के लिए प्रावधान : 4,000 | 76,000 |
| कर्मचारी लाभ भाजन कोष | 45,000 | निवेश | 90,000 |
| **पूँजी खाता :** | | भवन | 60,000 |
| चाँदनी : 1,00,000 | | मशीनरी | 25,000 |
| निहार : 80,000 | 1,80,000 | | |
| **कुल** | **3,07,000** | **कुल** | **3,07,000** |

1-4-2016 को, उन्होंने निम्नलिखित शर्तों पर पायल को नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया:
(1) पायल ख्याति के रूप में ₹ 20,000 नकद लाई।
(2) संदिग्ध ऋण के लिए प्रावधान की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
(3) मशीनरी का मूल्य 10% कम किया जाना है।
(4) भवन का बाजार मूल्य ₹ 1,00,000 है।
(5) निवेश का बाजार मूल्य ₹ 98,500 है।
(6) पायल नई फर्म में चाँदनी और निहार की कुल पूँजी का 20% अपनी पूँजी के रूप में लाएगी।
(7) नया लाभ विभाजन अनुपात 2:2:1 रखा जाना है।
(8) चाँदनी और निहार अपनी पूँजी को अपने नए लाभ और हानि विभाजन अनुपात के अनुपात में बनाए रखेंगे।

आवश्यक खाते और आर्थिक चिट्ठा तैयार करें।
solution:
**Revaluation Account**
| Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| To Machinery A/c | 2,500 | By Doubtful debt reserve A/c | 4,000 |
| To Profit transferred to old partners' capital A/c | | By Building A/c | 40,000 |
| Chandni : 30,000 | | By Investment A/c | 8,500 |
| Nihar : 20,000 | 50,000 | | |
| **Total** | **52,500** | **Total** | **52,500** |

**Partners' Capital Accounts**
| Particulars | Chandni (₹) | Nihar (₹) | Payal (₹) | Particulars | Chandni (₹) | Nihar (₹) | Payal (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| To Bank A/c | 26,800 | - | - | By Balance b/d | 1,00,000 | 80,000 | - |
| To Balance c/d | 1,34,000 | 1,34,000 | 53,600 | By General reserve A/c | 7,200 | 4,800 | - |
| | | | | By Investment fluctuation reserve A/c | 3,600 | 2,400 | - |
| | | | | By Premium for goodwill A/c | 20,000 | - | - |
| | | | | By Revaluation A/c | 30,000 | 20,000 | - |
| | | | | By Bank A/c | - | 26,800 | 53,600 |
| **Total** | **1,60,800** | **1,34,000** | **53,600** | **Total** | **1,60,800** | **1,34,000** | **53,600** |

**Cash / Bank Account**
| Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| To Balance b/d | 56,000 | By Chandni's capital A/c | 26,800 |
| To Premium for goodwill A/c | 20,000 | By Balance c/d | 1,29,600 |
| To Payal's capital A/c | 53,600 | | |
| To Nihar's capital A/c | 26,800 | | |
| **Total** | **1,56,400** | **Total** | **1,56,400** |

**Balance Sheet as on 1-4-2016 after Admission**
| Liabilities | Amt. (₹) | Assets | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Capital Account :** | | Bank | 1,29,600 |
| Chandni : 1,34,000 | | Debtors | 80,000 |
| Nihar : 1,34,000 | | Investment | 98,500 |
| Payal : 53,600 | 3,21,600 | Building | 1,00,000 |
| Creditors | 64,000 | Machinery | 22,500 |
| Workmen profit sharing fund | 45,000 | | |
| **Total** | **4,30,600** | **Total** | **4,30,600** |

**Explanation:**
**(1) Sacrificing ratio**
Old profit-loss sharing ratio of Chandni and Nihar = 3:2
New profit-loss sharing ratio of Chandni, Nihar and Payal = 2:2:1
Sacrifice = Old share - New share
Chandni's sacrifice = 3/5 - 2/5 = 1/5
Nihar's sacrifice = 2/5 - 2/5 = 0
Note: Premium for goodwill is received by Chandni only.

**(2) Capital of Chandni, Nihar and Payal**
| Particulars | Chandni (₹) | Nihar (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Opening balance | 1,00,000 | 80,000 |
| General reserve | 7,200 | 4,800 |
| Investment fluctuation reserve | 3,600 | 2,400 |
| Premium for goodwill | 20,000 | - |
| Revaluation profit | 30,000 | 20,000 |
| **Total** | **1,60,800** | **1,07,200** |

Payal brought her share of capital, which is 20 % of total capital of Chandni and Nihar.
Chandni's capital = ₹ 1,60,800
Nihar's capital = ₹ 1,07,200
Total capital of Chandni and Nihar = ₹ 2,68,000
Payal's capital = 2,68,000 * 20/100 = ₹ 53,600

Chandni and Nihar maintained their total capital in their new profit sharing ratio.
Total capital of Chandni and Nihar is ₹ 2,68,000. New profit-loss sharing ratio = 2:2 = 1:1
Chandni's capital = 2,68,000 * 1/2 = ₹ 1,34,000
Nihar's capital = 2,68,000 * 1/2 = ₹ 1,34,000

question:
**Illustration 30:** Shivani and Niraj are the partners in a firm sharing profit and loss in the ratio of 1:2. Balance sheet of their firm as on 31-3-2016 was as under:

**Balance Sheet**

| Liabilities | Amt. (₹) | Assets | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Capital account :** | | Goodwill | 27,000 |
| Shivani : 1,00,000 | | Land-Building | 1,50,000 |
| Niraj : 1,50,000 | 2,50,000 | Machinery | 50,000 |
| Profit-loss A/c | 9,000 | Stock | 20,000 |
| General reserve | 15,000 | Debtors | 30,000 |
| Creditors | 25,000 | Bills receivable | 10,000 |
| Bad debt reserve | 8,000 | Cash | 20,000 |
| **Total** | **3,07,000** | **Total** | **3,07,000** |

They admitted Vijay as a new partner as on above date for the following terms:
(1) Bad debt reserve is to be kept ₹ 5,000 on debtors.
(2) Goodwill is valued at ₹ 36,000.
(3) Value of land and building is to be appreciated by 10 %.
(4) Book value of machinery is 25 % more than its market value.
(5) Value of stock is to be decreased by 10 %.
(6) Vijay will bring 50 % of net assets of new firm as the capital and his share of goodwill in cash.
(7) Shivani sacrifices 1/3rd of her share and Niraj sacrifices 1/3rd share for Vijay.

Prepare necessary accounts and balance sheet after admission of a new partner.
question_hi:
**चित्रण 30:** शिवानी और नीरज 1:2 के अनुपात में लाभ और हानि बाँटने वाले एक फर्म के साझेदार हैं। 31-3-2016 को उनकी फर्म का आर्थिक चिट्ठा इस प्रकार था:

**आर्थिक चिट्ठा**

| देयताएँ (Liabilities) | राशि (₹) | संपत्तियाँ (Assets) | राशि (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **पूँजी खाता :** | | ख्याति | 27,000 |
| शिवानी : 1,00,000 | | भूमि-भवन | 1,50,000 |
| नीरज : 1,50,000 | 2,50,000 | मशीनरी | 50,000 |
| लाभ-हानि खाता | 9,000 | स्टॉक | 20,000 |
| सामान्य संचय | 15,000 | देनदार | 30,000 |
| लेनदार | 25,000 | प्राप्य बिल | 10,000 |
| डूबत ऋण संचय | 8,000 | रोकड़ | 20,000 |
| **कुल** | **3,07,000** | **कुल** | **3,07,000** |

उन्होंने उपर्युक्त तिथि पर निम्नलिखित शर्तों पर विजय को नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया:
(1) देनदारों पर डूबत ऋण संचय ₹ 5,000 रखा जाना है।
(2) ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 36,000 किया गया है।
(3) भूमि और भवन के मूल्य में 10% की वृद्धि की जानी है।
(4) मशीनरी का बही मूल्य उसके बाजार मूल्य से 25% अधिक है।
(5) स्टॉक का मूल्य 10% कम किया जाना है।
